“ I have chiseled away all meaningless thoughts. „

Forged in the Mountain (Korean: ) is Halite Gauntlet Cookie's first Costume, released in the first half of the The Turmoil of Halite Monastery! update. It is a Super Epic Costume that could be obtained either by drawing it from the Geode Smash Draw or by purchasing it in the Golden Halite Exchange Shop for 290 Golden Halite.

Story

An uncut gem differs not from ordinary stone. Halite Gauntlet Cookie endlessly threw her dough at the rocky mountains while reflecting on the voices of times past. Arrogance and vanity, resentment and regret... Strike after strike, these coarse, unrefined emotions are chipped away until none remain. As the Gauntlet finished breaking away from all self-attachment, only her firm mind remained, forged anew. May she reveal her newly polished skills upon the Land of Martial Tarts.

Trivia

  • Forged in the Mountain was released alongside  Forged Beyond Breaking,  Fists of the Apex Ascendant,  Shrimp Crackers Connoisseur,  Shrimply Delicious,  Wisdom at the Summit, and  Shrimp Crackers Rescuer.
  • Forged in the Mountain is the first, and currently only, Super Epic Costume that is in a Set with a Category:Legendary Jelly Set.
  • When viewing Forged in the Mountain in the game's Collection, the Costume is marked with an orange "SEASON" banner in place of the regular "LIMITED" banner used for Limited Jelly Shapes and Cookie and Pet Costumes.
    • This is a banner shared with  Forged Beyond Breaking, the Indomitable Halite Crystal Set which were also obtainable from the Limited Season 11 Gacha.
